projection_contract.courtyard: Exact rectangles are retained. KiCad segmented courtyards are projected to their conservative axis-aligned bounding rectangle because CoHDL has one closed courtyard shape.
projection_contract.pads: Copper shape/size/position/rotation, solder-mask expansion, electrical number, and effective circular paste-aperture diameter are exact.
projection_contract.silkscreen: The source filled pin-1 polygon and Reference anchor are retained; other source package-outline and fabrication graphics are outside this focused land-pattern projection.
